1023.name: Special Technique - Retribution
1023.description: Deals a large amount of DMG to the enemy (Damage Factor: 8000) and increases Squad ATK by 24%. Lasts 3s.

1023.name: Special Technique - Eagle Dance
1023.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 15% and Travel Speed by 15%.

1023.name: Special Technique - Storm Array
1023.description: Squads' basic attacks have 10% chance to deal additional DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 4000).

1023.name: Special Technique - Talisman
1023.description: When Squad HP is lower than 50%, increases Ranged Squad ATK by 26% and Travel Speed by 18%.

1023.name: Special Technique - Kiai
1023.description: Increases DMG dealt to Infantry Squads by 10%.

1039.name: To Hell
1039.description: Deals DMG to up to 5 enemy Squads in a fan-shaped area (Damage Factor: 10000). DMG taken by each enemy Squad reduces by 15% for every additional target enemy Squad.

1039.name: Massacre Concerto
1039.description: Increases Skill DMG by 30%.Increases the HP of Ranged Squads by 10% when garrisoning.

1039.name: Sonata of Sorrow
1039.description: Squads gain an additional 25 Rage when using basic attacks.

1039.name: Perfect Curtain Call
1039.description: Deals DMG to up to 5 enemy Squads in a circular area (Damage Factor: 12000). DMG taken by each enemy Squad reduces by 15% for every additional target enemy Squad.

1080.name: Double Kill
1080.description: Deals DMG to 2 enemies in a straight line (Damage Factor 12000. When appointed as an Assistant, reduces DMG to 6000). If only one enemy is hit, increases DMG by 20%.

1080.name: Retribution
1080.description: When taking Skill DMG, restores 100 Rage instantly. There is a 50% chance to inflict Silence on the attacker for 3s. This effect triggers once every 6s.

1080.name: Battle Elite
1080.description: When in battle, increases Ranged Squad HP by 20% and ATK by 20%.

1080.name: Resilience
1080.description: When leading Ranged Squad(s) only, increases Skill DMG by 25% and Travel Speed by 30%.

1080.name: Swift Bolt
1080.description: Deals DMG to 2 enemies in a straight line (Damage Factor13000. When appointed as an Assistant, reduces DMG to 6500). If only one enemy is hit, increases DMG by 25%.

1082.name: Tough Strike
1082.description: Deals DMG to target (Damage Factor 12000) and reduces target's healing effect by 40% for 3s.

1082.name: Maverick
1082.description: When outside Alliance territory, increases Ranged Squad ATK by 30% and DEF by 10%.

1082.name: Serial Killer
1082.description: Increases Skill DMG by 4% every second, up to 40%. After an Assistant unleashes a Rage Skill, the buff will reset and stack again.

1082.name: Extermination
1082.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 20%. During Sieges, basic attacks have a 20% to deal an additional DMG [color=#20%](Damage Factor 3120.

1082.name: Lethal Toxins
1082.description: Deals DMG to target (Damage Factor 13750) and reduces target's healing effect by 50% for 5s.

1088.name: Bird of Prey
1088.description: Deals DMG to up to 3 enemies (Damage Factor: 12500) in a fan-shaped area in front, and increases own Counter DMG by 23% for 3s. DMG taken by each enemy Squad reduces by 15% for every additional target enemy Squad.

1088.name: Earth's Champion
1088.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 20%, and increases all DMG dealt by 7.5% when garrisoning.

1088.name: Dance with the Eagle
1088.description: Deals DMG to up to 3 nearby enemy Squads (Damage Factor: 2000) every 8s. If garrisoning, also reduces the ATK of these Squads by 17% for 2s.

1088.name: Son of the Wind
1088.description: Increases all DMG by 16% if the remaining Squad Size is below 50%. Increases all DMG to 20% if the remaining Squad Size is less than 30%.

1088.name: Eagle Strike
1088.description: Deals DMG to up to 3 enemies (Damage Factor: 13750) in a fan-shaped area in front, and increases own Counter DMG by 28% for 3s. DMG taken by each enemy Squad reduces by 15% for every additional target enemy Squad.

1089.name: Stunning Magic
1089.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 12500) and restores 100 Rage to own Squad.

1089.name: Escape Preparation
1089.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 20%, and increases Ranged Squad DEF by 20%.

1089.name: Mind Reading
1089.description: Reduces DMG taken from basic attacks by 20%. When Rage is more than 90%, increases Skill DMG dealt by 17% for 4s.

1089.name: Impenetrable
1089.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 40%. There is a 60% chance of being immune to taking increased DMG.

1089.name: Miracle of the Century
1089.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 13750) and inflicts Silence on the enemy for 3s. Also restores 120 Rage to own Squad.

1096.name: Mass Annihilation
1096.description: Deals DMG to up to 3 enemy targets in a circular area (Damage Factor: 13000). DMG taken by each enemy target reduces by 15% for every additional enemy target. If this skill kills an enemy Squad, has 50% chance to immediately recover 60 Rage.

1096.name: Purge Weakness
1096.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 30%. If the enemy is inflicted with Silence, increases basic attack DMG dealt to them by 21%.

1096.name: Invincible Fleet
1096.description: During Sieges, increases Ranged Squad DEF by 25% and HP by 25%.

1096.name: Direct Confrontation
1096.description: During Rallies, increase Skill DMG dealt to Garrison Squads by 54%, but all DMG taken from Garrison Squads is increased by 12.5%.

1096.name: Dominating the Seas
1096.description: Deals DMG to up to 3 enemy targets in a circular area (Damage Factor: 14300). DMG taken by each enemy target reduces by 15% for every additional enemy target. If this skill kills an enemy Squad, has 50% chance to immediately recover 65 Rage and increase own ATK by 30% for 3s.

1097.name: Precise Breakthrough
1097.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 11700). If Flanked when not Rallying or Garrisoned, deals additional DMG to the current target (Damage Factor: 3000) and reduces Skill DMG taken by 20% for 2s.

1097.name: Auto Fortify
1097.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 30%. If Flanked when not Rallying or Garrisoned, increases Ranged Squad DEF by 15%.

1097.name: Scan Weakness
1097.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 34%. Counterattacks have a 20% chance to reduce all DMG taken by 4.5% for 2s. This effect can be triggered only once in 4s.

1097.name: Tactical Maneuver
1097.description: Increases Counter DMG by 32% and Ranged Squad Travel Speed by 20%.

1097.name: High Output Mode
1097.description: When in World Map battles, increases Ranged Squad DMG by 3%. If Flanked when not Rallying or Garrisoned, reduces DMG taken by 10%.

1102.name: All Shots Fired
1102.description: Deals DMG to up to 3 enemies (Damage Factor: 13500) in a fan-shaped area in front, DMG taken by each enemy reduces by 15% for every additional enemy target. For every enemy target hit, gain 1 stack of Gunfire. If garrisoned, for every enemy target hit, gain 2 stacks of Gunfire instead. For every 10 stacks of Gunfire gained, increases Ranged Squad ATK by 10%.

1102.name: Gunfight Tactics
1102.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 42%. Counterattacks have a 20% chance to grant 1 stack of Gunfire.

1102.name: Tactical Deployment
1102.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 36% and reduces Squad's Skill DMG taken by 13% when garrisoned.

1102.name: Hunter Spirit
1102.description: Increases Ranged Squad DEF by 38%. If garrisoned, reduces all DMG taken by 10% for 1m after entering battle.

1102.name: Killer Instinct
1102.description: Increases DMG of AoE Skills by 18%. At 30 stacks of Gunfire, remove all Gunfire stacks to deal DMG to up to 3 enemies in a circular area [color=#18%](Damage Factor: 13500).

1103.name: Giant's Wrath
1103.description: Deals DMG to the current target (Damage Factor: 13500) and increases Skill DMG received by nearby enemies, up to 3 enemies, by 20% for 3s.

1103.name: Shoulder Ride
1103.description: Increases Ranged Squad TRVL SPD by 20% and ATK by 32% when not rallying.

1103.name: Giant's Counterattack
1103.description: When using Rage Skills without Charge, gains Charge. When using Rage Skills with Charge, consumes Charge to deal DMG to up to 3 Squads in a circular area (Damage Factor: 7850). Charge: Increases Ranged Squad DMG by 10%.

1103.name: Bottled Dream
1103.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 32%, and increases Ranged Squad DMG Reduction by 5.5%.

1103.name: Giant's Authority
1103.description: Immediately gains Charge for 15s when entering battle. Every time Charge is consumed, there is a 30% chance to deal DMG again.

1108.name: Weakness Detection
1108.description: Increases Squad ATK by 46%. Squads' basic attacks deal bonus DMG [color=#46%](Damage Factor: 3750). Lasts 2s.

1108.name: Point and Shoot
1108.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 18%. During Sieges, increases Squads' basic attack DMG by 24%.

1108.name: Dynamic Vision
1108.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 15% and DEF by 15%.

1108.name: Camouflage
1108.description: Reduces Counter DMG received by 17%. Basic attacks have a 20% chance to reduce enemy DEF by 16% for 3s.

1108.name: Flying Bullets
1108.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 20% and DEF by 20%. Also, reduces research time for all Technologies in the Research Lab by 0.5h, and increases research speed by 12%. This effect applies even when not deployed.

1110.name: Dance of Slaughter
1110.description: Deals direct DMG to the target  (Damage Factor: 14000). When not garrisoned, deals additional damage to target and 2 other targets around self once (Damage Factor: 2500).

1110.name: Shadow in the Fog
1110.description: Increases Ranged Squad DEF by 30%. During Rallies, increases Ranged Squad DMG by 10%.

1110.name: Night of Assassination
1110.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 30%. During Rallies, counterattacks have a 30% chance to deal damage to Squads in the field [color=#30%](Damage Factor: 2000). This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 3s.

1110.name: Perfect Attire
1110.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 30%. Reduces Skill DMG taken from Garrison Squads by 12%.

1110.name: Bloody Storm
1110.description: Reduces current target's Skill DMG by 3% and Squad HP by 4% when Cedric uses a Rage Skill. This effect stacks up to 3 times, and lasts for 30s.

1111.name: Magic Marksman
1111.description: Deals damage to the target (Damage Factor 14000). If the target is Flanked, the Damage Factor is increased to 15500. When not garrisoned, reduces enemy ATK by an additional 30% for 3s.

1111.name: Aurora Veil
1111.description: Increased Ranged Squad HP by 25%. When taking Skill DMG, reduces DMG taken by own Ranged Squad by 20% for 3s. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 10s.

1111.name: Prism Ruling
1111.description: Increases Ranged Squad DEF by 20%. When performing basic attacks, there is a 20% chance to steal 50 Rage from the enemy. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 4s.

1111.name: Shining Moment
1111.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 20% and increases TRVL SPD by 20%. If target is Flanked, increases DMG received by 15% for 3s after using a Rage Skill.

1111.name: Precise Reflection
1111.description: Increases Ranged Squad DEF by 25%. When performing basic attacks, there is a 20% chance to steal 50 Rage from the enemy. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 4s. After successfully stealing Rage, also steals 8% of Skill DMG from the enemy for 3s.

1117.name: One-Shot Kill
1117.description: Deals DMG to the current target (Damage Factor: 14500), reducing their HP by 40% for 3s. While in the Aiming state, increases this DMG by 20%.

1117.name: Focused Breath
1117.description: Enters the Aiming state for 30s when entering battle. When not in a Rally or garrisoned, if not in the Aiming state, Charon uses a Rage Skill and enters the Aiming state for 10s. Aiming: Increases Rage Recovery Speed by 10%.

1117.name: Evasive Maneuver
1117.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 30%, and increases Travel Speed by 20%. While in the Aiming state, reduces Counter DMG taken by 20%.

1117.name: Position Shift
1117.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 30%. If flanked when not in a Rally or garrisoned, increases Ranged Squad DEF by an additional 20%.

1117.name: Death Radius
1117.description: Deals DMG to the current target (Damage Factor: 15000), and deals DMG (Damage Factor: 5000) to 2 other nearby enemy targets, reducing their HP by 40% for 3s. While in the Aiming state, increases this DMG by 20%.

1118.name: Multithreaded Breach
1118.description: Deals DMG to up to 3 enemies in a fan-shaped area (Damage Factor: 14500, increased to 16500 when garrisoned). DMG taken by each enemy Squad reduces by 15% for every 1 additional target enemy Squads. Also reduces Skill DMG dealt by target Squads by 10% for 2s.

1118.name: Warm-Up Stream
1118.description: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 40%. When garrisoned, increases Rage Recovery Speed by 10% for the first 1m after entering battle.

1118.name: Extreme Speedrun
1118.description: When not in a Rally, increases Ranged Squad DEF by 35% and Ranged Squad DMG Reduction by 8%.

1118.name: Virtual Avatar
1118.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 40%. When garrisoned, reduces Skill DMG taken by 12%.

1118.name: Cheat Code
1118.description: Gains 1 stacks of Cheat Code before the Leader uses a Rage Skill when not in a Rally. At 6 stacks, removes all stacks, increases Ranged Squad DMG by 10% for 3s, and if the Leader has a Ranged Squad Talent, the Leader will use a Rage Skill again the next second after the Assistant uses a Rage Skill. Cheat Code: Increases Ranged Squad ATK by 3%.

1124.name: Prelude to Death
1124.description: Deals damage to the target (Damage Factor 15000). When not garrisoned, the Damage Factor is increased to 18000, and increases DMG Reduction by 3% for every 1 nearby Squads when using the Skill. This effect stacks up to 3 times, and lasts for 3s.

1124.name: Marionette Aria
1124.description: During Rallies, increases Ranged Squad ATK by 40% and increases damage dealt to Infantry Squads by 10%.

1124.name: Phantom Variation
1124.description: Increases Ranged Squad DEF by 30%. When taking Skill DMG, there is a 30% chance to recover HP [color=#30%](Heal Factor: 3000). This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 6s.

1124.name: Puppet Rhapsody
1124.description: Increases Ranged Squad HP by 40%. During Rallies, counterattacks have a 25% chance to deal damage to Squads in the field [color=#40%](Damage Factor: 2500). This DMG increases by 100% in the first 1 minutes of battle.

1124.name: Curtain Call Waltz
1124.description: Prelude to Death additionally reduces the target's DEF by 6%. This effect stacks up to 5 times, and lasts for 30s. Reduces Shield Effect of targets that reach the stack limit by 30% and increases own Skill DMG dealt to them by 15%.

1125.name: Final Judgment
1125.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 15000). When not in a Rally or garrisoned, heals up to 3 nearby allies based on [color=#30%]30% of this DMG dealt.

1125.name: Path of Redemption
1125.description: When not in a Rally or garrisoned, increases own healing effect granted by [color=#20%]20%. For every 30% of Squad Size lost, additionally increases this by [color=#20%]10%.

1125.name: Breath of Dawn
1125.description: [Final Judgment] Additionally increases DMG of Squads that receive healing by 10%. This effect stacks up to 2 times, and lasts for 10s.

1125.name: Apocalyptic Dance
1125.description: Ranged Squad HP increases by 40%, and Travel Speed increases by 20%.

1125.name: Ashen Huntres
1125.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 16000). When not in a Rally or garrisoned, heals up to 5 nearby allies based on [color=#35%]35% of this DMG dealt.

1203.name: Resonance Shots
1203.description: Deals DMG to the current target (Damage Factor: 13500). When not Rallying or Garrisoned, recover HP based on the number of Squads flanking the enemy Squad (Flanking Squads x550). This effect counts up to 5 Flanking Squads.

1203.name: Coordinated Tactics
1203.description: Increases Squad HP by 30%. Basic attacks grant 10 Rage when flanking the enemy.

1203.name: Flanking Operation
1203.description: When not Rallying or Garrisoned, increases Skill DMG by 36% when remaining Squad Size is 50% or more. When Squad Size is less than 50%, reduces Skill DMG taken by 36% and increases Ranged Squad TRVL SPD by 20%.

1203.name: Speedy Travel
1203.description: Increases Squad TRVL SPD by 20% and ATK by 30%.

1203.name: Perfect Sync
1203.description: Deals DMG to the current target (Damage Factor: 14850). When not Rallying or Garrisoned, recover HP based on the number of Squads flanking the enemy Squad (Flanking Squads x550).  The Assistant has a 50% recover additional HP (Flanking Squads x330) after casting a skill. This effect counts up to 5 Flanking Squads.
